cover: Drone kills eight on way to market
Author cites ₹5 lakh bounty in court
Deleted voters' appeals to be heard first

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: Drone hits a car bound for market
bullets: Women were among those in the vehicle, local sources say.
Believed to be an army drone; no side claimed it.

stories.label: Palestine
stories.head: UN worker killed at a water well
bullets: Adel al-Helo was killed on 23 Nov; three were wounded.
Two more died in a strike in Gaza City.
Israel's military said it was checking the report.

stories.label: India · Speech
stories.head: Ravi Hanj asks court to quash FIR
bullets: He says the bounty threatens his right to life.
The FIR is over his book 'Basava Mantapa'.
Police booked the bounty announcer; he apologised.

stories.label: India · Right upheld
stories.head: Deleted voters to be heard first
bullets: Tribunals told to defer challenges to inclusions.
Election Commission asked to add tribunals.
The Solicitor General questioned bypassing High Courts.
